part.text: Read-only privacy review — running the trace-policy checks without edits.
Files reviewed — now executing the unit test suite.

Independent read-only privacy review — `trace-policy-v1`:

Scope obeyed: read-only. Read 7 files in `tools/php83/baseline-rehearsal/privacy/trace-policy-v1/` (`README.md`, `prepare.py`, `writer-methods.php.inc`, `probe.php`, `validate.py`, `test_prepare.py`, `test_validate.py`). No edits, no `/tmp` reads, no VM/SSH/auth, no compiler ops.

Executed:
`python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/php83/baseline-rehearsal/privacy/trace-policy-v1 -p test_*.py -v`
Result: 17 tests ran, OK — 11x `test_prepare.Tests` + 6x `test_validate.Tests`. All `ok`.

Source verdict (bounded, static-only):

1. Throwable/previous preservation + event/filter/priority:
- `writer-methods.php.inc:9-35`: `throwableForLog(Throwable)` builds display string via `getClass/getMessage/getCode/getFile/getLine/getTrace/getPrevious`, `do...while !==null`, `array_reverse(chain)` = oldest-first. No `setMessage/setTrace/serialize/clone`.
- `writer-methods.php.inc:2-7`: `_write($event)` copies array by value, replaces only `$event['message']` if `instanceof Throwable`, then `parent::_write`. No new properties, `__sleep/__wakeup` untouched per README.
- `probe.php:19-28,50-56,62-66`: observer filter + wrapping formatter capture pre-`_write` event; `validate.py:11,13,21` enforces `exception_state_unchanged`, `observed_same_bytes`, `structural_preserved`, `context_preserved`, `writer_same_message`, `formatter_type==string`, priority `{alert:1, crit:2, else:3}`, rejected-ERR control `empty_sink/observer_not_called/formatter_not_called`. Contract present.

2. Three Error-before-stringify guards:
- `prepare.py:16-18`: anchors on exactly 3x `if(!$message instanceof Exception)` in `old.TARGETS[0]`, replaces with `Throwable`. Guarded by `test_guard_only_three_changes` + `test_double_application`/`test_missing_anchor`. Composes exp14, does not replace other targets (`test_known_copies_unchanged`).

3. No argument value cast:
- `writer-methods.php.inc:26`: `'[REDACTED:'.gettype($argument).']'` only. Prohibited `preg_replace/getTraceAsString/__toString/setTrace/setMessage/serialize(/clone` asserted absent in `test_no_generic_replacement_or_mutation`. `probe.php:68,85,121` adds `ExplosiveDisplay::__toString` throwing `MUST_NOT_STRINGIFY` + 6-type `mixedArguments` exact-match check. Static guard passes.

4. Original leak + negative controls:
- `validate.py:2,22`: 11 exact cases. `policy=False` requires `prefix_marker` leak (original leak control). `policy=True` requires positives have no `full/prefix_marker` + `redaction_marker`; negatives `intrinsic/prerendered/extras-control` must still leak `prefix_marker` (+ `full_marker` except prerendered). `README.md:19-25` + `validate.py:1,24` explicitly `privacy_acceptance:False`, `KNOWN_LEAKS_PRESERVED` — not a privacy PASS.

5. Writer serialization probe (source only, not executed):
- `probe.php:46-49,88`: `writer-roundtrip` does `unserialize(serialize(writer))` + subsequent write. `validate.py` enforces same inventory/contract for it. No PHP runtime evidence in this run.

Defects found in reviewed files: none blocking the stated bounded display-copy contract. No concrete code defect to file from static review.

Native/acceptance gaps (not ready):
- PHP `probe.php` NOT_EXECUTED here; native `paired74/copied83`, serialization round-trip behavior, argument-type rendering, effective logger config + exercised-emitter audit, and whole-privacy acceptance remain open per `README.md:32-34,42-51`.
- 17 passing tests are static/source/replay/contract-mutant guards only, not PHP execution or deployment approval.
